about.title: About the Artist
bio: Peggy Granlund is a passionate artist working in the archipelago environment of Tyresö Brevik. Her visual world is shaped by places she has visited and by what is close at hand – animals, objects, and memory images that over time become expressions in her painting.

Peggy is driven by the creative process itself. She moves freely between detailed, time-consuming works and a more spontaneous, intuitive painting where feeling and movement take the lead. For her, both approaches are equally valuable.

Each painting carries its own story while simultaneously leaving room for the viewer's interpretation. Peggy highly values the encounter between image and viewer and sees it as something living, where new meanings can emerge in the conversation around the art. When a painting evokes memories, feelings, or personal stories in others, the work becomes complete.
